newsitem.title: USA: Schering's Claritin syrup cleared by FDA.
newsitem.headline: Schering's Claritin syrup cleared by FDA.

text.p: Schering-Plough Corp said on Monday it received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance to market Claritin Syrup.
The company described the drug as the first nondrowsy antihistamine syrup for children as young as six years.
In addition, the FDA expanded the use of Claritin tablets to include children age six and up, Schering-Plough said.

The syrup is a member of Schering's Claritin brand, launched in the U.S. in 1993. Available only by prescription in a once-daily formula, the syrup is for treating allergy symptoms, including itchy, watery eyes and runny nose.
